    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "e) Encounters where the only FC ID was Voided/Deleted (priority 99) are excluded" & _
        " from the denominator entirely. This month: " & voidedTotal & " encounter(s) excluded."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "3. FILE B CLEANING (skipped entirely when File B is not provided)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only Missed FC = 'Yes'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled' or 'Planned'."
    r = r + 1

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Emergency (EM) rows are all File A rows with Admission Type = Emergency."

    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "5. DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator = (unique encounters from File A, excluding Voided/Deleted-only) + (Missed" & _

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Pink (priority 3): CCF explained but not signed."

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "White/none (priority 98): Draft only -- no FC outcome (see Section 2c)."

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Grey (Missed FC): no FC ID was ever created."
    r = r + 1

        " completed' figure. Splitting Drafts into their own band does not change this total or the overall" & _

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "7. WHO CLOSED THE CCF"

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B (or manual entry) missed FC rows are counted under 'CCF not generated'."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "8. CONSERVATIVE PRINCIPLE"

' ---- Staff Roster Check sheet --------------------------------------------

Private Sub BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileAws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object)

    If roster.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Config roster is empty -- run CreateConfigSheet " & _
            "(Alt+F8) and add staff names/teams before this check is meaningful."
        ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 80
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Cannot build roster check: Encounter column not found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    Dim nameSet As Object
    Set nameSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameSet.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim i As Long, nm As String
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            Dim cbData As Variant
            cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(cbData) Else nm = CellStr(cbData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            Dim lcData As Variant
            lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(lcData) Else nm = CellStr(lcData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Dim teamOrder As Variant
    teamOrder = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teamOrder) To UBound(teamOrder)
        Dim teamName As String
        teamName = CStr(teamOrder(t))

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = teamName
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 11
        r = r + 1

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name"
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
        r = r + 1

        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In roster.Keys
            If CStr(roster(k)) = teamName Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = CStr(k)
                If nameSet.Exists(CStr(k)) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Matched"
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                End If
                r = r + 1
            End If
        Next k

        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Main orchestrator ---------------------------------------------------

' fileBws may be Nothing (File B is optional -- Decision 5). When Nothing,
' missedFCManualCount (from FilePickerForm's dashboard-workaround input) is
' used instead, attributed entirely to EM (see WriteMethodologySheet Section 1).
'
' ncidPocList: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadNCIDPointOfCareList. An empty
' Dictionary means the EL sheet/statistics are skipped entirely this run
' (Decision 1) -- EM is still produced normally.
Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, voidedOnlyCount As Long, _
        missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    Dim elComputed As Boolean
    elComputed = (ncidPocList.Count > 0)

    If Not elComputed Then
        MsgBox "The Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list (column D) is empty." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
               "EL (Elective Inpatient / NCID AO) statistics will be SKIPPED for this report -- only EM " & _
               "will be produced. Paste the real Point of Care ward text values into that list and re-run " & _
               "to get EL and Combined figures.", vbExclamation, "NCID Point of Care Not Configured"
    End If

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 3
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither --
    ' excluded from both sheets). Computed once here, consumed by
    ' WriteFilteredFileASheet so the EL sheet honours the Point of Care gate.
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long, elPocExcluded As Long, elSkippedCount As Long

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (gated on NCID Point of Care), or
        ' 0 = neither / excluded (Decision 1).
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf admType = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE) Then
            If elComputed Then
                Dim pocVal As String
                pocVal = ""
                If pocCol > 0 Then pocVal = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))
                If ncidPocList.Exists(pocVal) Then
                    sec = SEC_EL
                Else
                    sec = 0
                    elPocExcluded = elPocExcluded + 1
                End If
            Else
                sec = 0
                elSkippedCount = elSkippedCount + 1
            End If
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            If pri = 99 Then
                voidCt(sec) = voidCt(sec) + 1
            Else
                encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1

                If pri <= 2 Then
                    greenCt(sec) = greenCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri = 3 Then
                    pinkCt(sec) = pinkCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
                    ltGreenCt(sec) = ltGreenCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri = 6 Then
                    orangeCt(sec) = orangeCt(sec) + 1
                Else   ' pri = 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
                    draftCt(sec) = draftCt(sec) + 1
                    Dim statusText As String
                    statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                    If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"
                    If unrecognisedStatuses.Exists(statusText) Then
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) + 1
                    Else
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = 1
                    End If
                End If

                Dim teamDict As Object
                If sec = SEC_EM Then Set teamDict = emTeams Else Set teamDict = elTeams
                teamDict(team) = teamDict(team) + 1

                If usedFallback Then blankCCF(sec) = blankCCF(sec) + 1

                ' Numerator detail
                Dim cbTeam As String, lcTeam As String
                cbTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
                lcTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, latestCCF)
                If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edInit(sec) = edInit(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edFull(sec) = edFull(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then inflFull(sec) = inflFull(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidFull(sec) = ncidFull(sec) + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' ---- Missed FC count: File B (split by Admission Type) or manual entry ----
    Dim missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedOther As Long
    Dim missedFCSourceLabel As String

    If hasFileB Then
        missedFCSourceLabel = "Inflight Missed FC Report"

        Dim bEncCol As Long
        bEncCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
        If bEncCol > 0 Then
            Dim bLastRow As Long
            bLastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, bEncCol).End(xlUp).Row

            If bLastRow >= 2 Then
                Dim bAdmTypeCol As Long
                bAdmTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileBws, "Admission Type")

                If bAdmTypeCol > 0 Then
                    Dim bAdmData As Variant
                    bAdmData = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(2, bAdmTypeCol), _
                        fileBws.Cells(bLastRow, bAdmTypeCol)).Value

                    Dim bi As Long
                    For bi = 1 To bLastRow - 1
                        Dim bAdmVal As String
                        If bLastRow = 2 Then
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData))
                        Else
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData(bi, 1)))
                        End If

                        If bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
                            missedEM = missedEM + 1
                        ElseIf bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE) Then
                            missedEL = missedEL + 1
                        Else
                            missedOther = missedOther + 1
                        End If
                    Next bi
                Else
                    missedEM = bLastRow - 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Else
        missedFCSourceLabel = "manual entry (dashboard workaround)"
        missedEM = missedFCManualCount
        missedEL = 0
        missedOther = 0
    End If

    ' ---- Get report period label ----
    Dim reportLabel As String
    reportLabel = GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws)
    If reportLabel = "" Then reportLabel = "Unknown Period"

    Dim voidedTotal As Long
    voidedTotal = voidCt(1) + voidCt(2)

    ' ---- Create output workbook ----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim outWb As Workbook
    Set outWb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    ' EM sheet -- always produced
    Dim wsEM As Worksheet
    Set wsEM = outWb.Sheets(1)
    wsEM.Name = SHEET_EM
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEM, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EM
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEM

    ' EL sheet -- only when the NCID Point of Care list is configured (Decision 1)
    If elComputed Then
        Dim wsEL As Worksheet
        Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
        WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
        HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL
    End If

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided (Decision 5)
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, elComputed, elSkippedCount, elPocExcluded, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, elComputed, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    MsgBox "Unexpected error building output workbook:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    BuildOutputWorkbook = False
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "BuildOutput"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' BuildOutput.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A, gated on the
'     Config "NCID EL Point of Care" list -- Decision 1, 2026-07-29)
'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
'   - Summary sheet (five-band colour-coded completion + team breakdown --
'     Decision 3)
'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check)
'
' 2026-07-29 conflict resolution against "Guide to monthly processing of
' report 3.docx" changed several rules here -- see Decisions 1, 2, 3, 5 in
' the commit/PR description and docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"
Public Const SHEET_MISSED_FC As String = "Missed FC"
Public Const SHEET_SUMMARY As String = "Summary"
Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"
Public Const SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK As String = "Staff Roster Check"

Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE  As String = "Elective Inpatient"

' Section codes used in secArr() (see BuildOutputWorkbook):
'   1 = EM (Emergency)
'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient, Point of Care matched the NCID list)
'   0 = neither -- excluded from both sheets, reported separately
Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2

' ---- Date parsing (eFC export format) ------------------------------------

Private Function TryParseDMYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim datePart As String
    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
    Else
        datePart = Trim(dateText)
    End If

    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseDMYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
        TryParseDMYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim d As Long, m As Long, y As Long
    d = CLng(parts(0)): m = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000

    On Error GoTo Fail
    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
    TryParseDMYDate = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseDMYDate = False
End Function

Public Function GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim admDateCol As Long
    admDateCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Date")
    If admDateCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, admDateCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, admDateCol)).Value

    Dim counts As Object
    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, txt As String, parsed As Date, key As String
    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If lastRow = 2 Then txt = CStr(data) Else txt = CStr(data(i, 1))
        If TryParseDMYDate(txt, parsed) Then
            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    If counts.Count = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim bestKey As String, bestCount As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In counts.Keys
        If counts(k) > bestCount Then bestCount = counts(k): bestKey = CStr(k)
    Next k

    Dim pts() As String
    pts = Split(bestKey, "-")
    GetReportPeriodLabel = MonthName(CLng(pts(1)), False) & CStr(CLng(pts(0)))
End Function

' ---- Small helpers -------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub InitTeamCounts(d As Object)
    d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    d(TEAM_ED_EDFC) = 0
    d(TEAM_INFLIGHT) = 0
    d(TEAM_NCID_AO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ICH_PSO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ADMIN) = 0
    d(TEAM_OTHERS) = 0
End Sub

Private Function AddSheet(wb As Workbook, sheetName As String) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
    ws.Name = sheetName
    Set AddSheet = ws
End Function

Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ws As Worksheet, lastCol As Long)
    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Rows(1).AutoFilter
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Function SafePct(num As Long, denom As Long) As Double
    If denom > 0 Then SafePct = num / denom Else SafePct = 0
End Function

Private Function CellStr(v As Variant) As String
    CellStr = Trim(CStr(v))
End Function

' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -

' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass. Using a pre-computed array
' (rather than re-deriving from Admission Type text, as the old version did)
' is what lets the EL sheet honour the NCID Point of Care gate (Decision 1) --
' an Elective Inpatient row whose Point of Care isn't in the configured list
' gets secArr(i) = 0 and is excluded from both EM and EL.
Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long

    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
    Next i

    For j = 1 To outCols
        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
    Next j

    If matchCount = 0 Then
        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
    Dim outRow As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To outCols
                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
End Function

' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------

Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
End Sub

' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------

Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Summary sheet -------------------------------------------------------

' Decision 3 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): five colour bands instead of
' four, with Drafts/unrecognised (priority 98) split out into their own
' White/none band rather than folded into Red. A "Not completed (total)"
' subtotal (Orange + Draft + Missed) keeps the old single headline figure
' available. The colour NAMES shift meaning vs. the pre-2026-07-29 code: what
' was "Light Green" is now "Pink" (priority 3), and what was "Orange" is now
' "Light Green" (priority 4-5) -- parameter names below match the NEW bands.
Private Sub WriteSummaryBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, _
        teamD As Object, blankCCFCt As Long, _
        edInit As Long, edFull As Long, inflFull As Long, ncidFull As Long)

    Dim denom As Long
    denom = encCount + missedCount

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
    If missedCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ws.Cells(r, 1).Value & _
            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
            missedSourceLabel & ")"
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Completion status table (five colour bands) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Completion Status"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Green (priority 1-2)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(greenCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
    r = r + 1

    ' Pink (priority 3)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF explained but not signed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(pinkCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)
    r = r + 1

    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Attempted, no further follow-up"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ltGreenCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(ltGreenCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
    r = r + 1

    ' Orange (priority 6)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(orangeCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
    r = r + 1

    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(draftCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(missedCount, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    r = r + 1

    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Missed. The overall
    ' completion % is unchanged by splitting Draft out into its own row;
    ' this subtotal keeps the single headline "not completed" figure.
    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(notCompletedTotal, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
    Dim bandSum As Long
    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(bandSum, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    If bandSum <> denom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Who closed the CCF ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim teams As Variant
    teams = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, _
                  TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN, TEAM_OTHERS)
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teams) To UBound(teams)
        Dim tName As String
        tName = CStr(teams(t))
        Dim tCount As Long
        tCount = 0
        If teamD.Exists(tName) Then tCount = teamD(tName)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = tName
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = tCount
        ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(tCount, denom)
        ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF not generated (Missed FC)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(missedCount, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 1
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True

    If blankCCFCt > 0 Then
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  (" & blankCCFCt & _
            " encounter(s) had blank 'Latest CCF Creation User' -- fell back to 'FC Created By')"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- FC Activity Detail ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Activity Detail"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC created by EDFC (initial -- FC Created By)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edInit
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by EDFC (Latest CCF Creation User)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by Inflight"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = inflFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by NCID AO"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ncidFull
    r = r + 3
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _
        elComputed As Boolean, elSkippedCount As Long, elPocExcluded As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull

    If elComputed Then
        ' ---- EL block ----
        WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
            elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, _
            elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull

        ' ---- Combined block ----
        Dim combTeams As Object
        Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        InitTeamCounts combTeams
        Dim tk As Variant
        For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
            combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
        Next tk

        WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
            emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
            emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, emDraft + elDraft, _
            combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
            emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
            emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) / COMBINED -- NOT COMPUTED"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list (column D) is empty, " & _
            "so EL (Elective Inpatient / NCID AO) statistics were skipped this run. Paste the real " & _
            "Point of Care ward text values into that list and re-run to get EL and Combined figures."
        r = r + 1
        If elSkippedCount > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = elSkippedCount & " Elective Inpatient encounter(s) in File A were " & _
                "found but not processed because of this."
            r = r + 1
        End If
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters excluded from denominator: " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If elPocExcluded > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective Inpatient encounters excluded from EL (Point of Care not in " & _
            "the configured NCID list), set aside and reported separately: " & elPocExcluded
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block (Decision 2) ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 60
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
End Sub

' ---- Methodology sheet ---------------------------------------------------

Private Sub WriteMethodologySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _
        voidedTotal As Long, elComputed As Boolean, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatusCount As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Methodology -- FC Completion Report " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "1. INPUTS"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File A: FC Summary Report (eFC export, full month, Emergency + Elective Inpatient)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B: Inflight Missed FC Report (eFC export, Missed FC indicator ticked) -- OPTIONAL."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "This month's Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel & "."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "If File B is not provided, the Missed FC count is entered manually (dashboard " & _
        "workaround) and is attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) -- the dashboard workaround does not " & _
        "distinguish Elective/NCID AO missed cases, so EL's own Missed FC count is 0 for that month."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "2. FILE A CLEANING"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only FC Mode = 'Financial Counselling - AH' or 'Financial Counselling - Downtime'" & _
        " (en dash / em dash variants in the export are normalised to a hyphen before comparing)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) Rank each FC ID by status priority: 1 = Completed, 2 = Acknowledgement by other means," & _
        " 3 = Virtual FC pending signature, 4-5 = Attempted/declined, 6 = Attempted, unable to complete,"
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   98 = anything else not explicitly listed (Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC" & _
        " statuses -- still counted in the denominator as not completed), 99 = Voided/Deleted (matched by" & _
        " substring, e.g. 'Voided', 'Deleted by Admin' -- excluded from the denominator entirely)."
    r = r + 1
    If unrecognisedStatusCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   This month: " & unrecognisedStatusCount & " distinct unrecognised (priority 98)" & _
            " status value(s) were seen -- see the warning block on the Summary sheet for the list and counts."
        r = r + 1
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "d) For encounters with multiple FC IDs: the plain rule is 'lowest priority wins, tie-" & _
        "break by larger (newer) FC ID'. The narrow Inflight exception only overrides this when (a) a non-" & _
        "Inflight candidate in the group was created by ED/EDFC staff, AND (b) the resulting winner (picked" & _
        " from the non-Inflight candidates) has priority <= 2 -- otherwise the plain rule stands."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   This month: Inflight exception applied to " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
        " encounter(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain rule) for " & _
        inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "e) Encounters where the only FC ID was Voided/Deleted (priority 99) are excluded" & _
        " from the denominator entirely. This month: " & voidedTotal & " encounter(s) excluded."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "3. FILE B CLEANING (skipped entirely when File B is not provided)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only Missed FC = 'Yes'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled' or 'Planned'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) EDVW discharges (Point Of Care = 'TTSH Virtual Ward', Accommodation Code = 'EDVW')" & _
        " are flagged but still counted."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "4. EM/EL SPLIT"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Emergency (EM) rows are all File A rows with Admission Type = Emergency."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective Inpatient (EL) rows require BOTH Admission Type = Elective Inpatient AND" & _
        " Point of Care in the Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list -- an Elective Inpatient row whose" & _
        " Point of Care is NOT in that list is set aside and reported separately, not silently dropped."
    r = r + 1
    If elComputed Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL was computed this run (the NCID Point of Care list is configured)."
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL was NOT computed this run -- the NCID Point of Care list (Config, column D)" & _
            " is empty. See the Summary sheet for details and how many rows this affected."
    End If
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "A 'Looks Wrong' flag marks EM rows closed by NCID AO or EL rows closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "5. DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator = (unique encounters from File A, excluding Voided/Deleted-only) + (Missed" & _
        " FC count, from File B or manual entry -- see Section 1)."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "6. COMPLETION STATUS BANDS"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Green (priority 1-2): FC Completed with written acknowledgement."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Pink (priority 3): CCF explained but not signed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Light Green (priority 4-5): Attempted, no further follow-up."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Orange (priority 6): FC not completed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "White/none (priority 98): Draft only -- no FC outcome (see Section 2c)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Grey (Missed FC): no FC ID was ever created."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "'Not completed (total)' = Orange + White/none + Grey -- the single headline 'not" & _
        " completed' figure. Splitting Drafts into their own band does not change this total or the overall" & _
        " completion percentage, only the presentation."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "7. WHO CLOSED THE CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Team is determined by 'Latest CCF Creation User' via the Config roster."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "If 'Latest CCF Creation User' is blank (pure Draft, no CCF generated), falls back to 'FC Created By'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "These fallback rows are highlighted yellow on the EM/EL data sheets."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B (or manual entry) missed FC rows are counted under 'CCF not generated'."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "8. CONSERVATIVE PRINCIPLE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "When a case is ambiguous or borderline, it is counted as NOT completed / missed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unrecognised FC Status values are priority 98 (not completed, but still in the" & _
        " denominator) -- only Voided/Deleted is excluded from the denominator entirely (priority 99)."

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 100
End Sub

' ---- Staff Roster Check sheet --------------------------------------------

Private Sub BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileAws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object)

    If roster.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Config roster is empty -- run CreateConfigSheet " & _
            "(Alt+F8) and add staff names/teams before this check is meaningful."
        ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 80
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Cannot build roster check: Encounter column not found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    Dim nameSet As Object
    Set nameSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameSet.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim i As Long, nm As String
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            Dim cbData As Variant
            cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(cbData) Else nm = CellStr(cbData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            Dim lcData As Variant
            lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(lcData) Else nm = CellStr(lcData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Dim teamOrder As Variant
    teamOrder = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teamOrder) To UBound(teamOrder)
        Dim teamName As String
        teamName = CStr(teamOrder(t))

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = teamName
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 11
        r = r + 1

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name"
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
        r = r + 1

        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In roster.Keys
            If CStr(roster(k)) = teamName Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = CStr(k)
                If nameSet.Exists(CStr(k)) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Matched"
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                End If
                r = r + 1
            End If
        Next k

        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Main orchestrator ---------------------------------------------------

' fileBws may be Nothing (File B is optional -- Decision 5). When Nothing,
' missedFCManualCount (from FilePickerForm's dashboard-workaround input) is
' used instead, attributed entirely to EM (see WriteMethodologySheet Section 1).
'
' ncidPocList: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadNCIDPointOfCareList. An empty
' Dictionary means the EL sheet/statistics are skipped entirely this run
' (Decision 1) -- EM is still produced normally.
Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, voidedOnlyCount As Long, _
        missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    Dim elComputed As Boolean
    elComputed = (ncidPocList.Count > 0)

    If Not elComputed Then
        MsgBox "The Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list (column D) is empty." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
               "EL (Elective Inpatient / NCID AO) statistics will be SKIPPED for this report -- only EM " & _
               "will be produced. Paste the real Point of Care ward text values into that list and re-run " & _
               "to get EL and Combined figures.", vbExclamation, "NCID Point of Care Not Configured"
    End If

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 3
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither --
    ' excluded from both sheets). Computed once here, consumed by
    ' WriteFilteredFileASheet so the EL sheet honours the Point of Care gate.
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long, elPocExcluded As Long, elSkippedCount As Long

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (gated on NCID Point of Care), or
        ' 0 = neither / excluded (Decision 1).
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf admType = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE) Then
            If elComputed Then
                Dim pocVal As String
                pocVal = ""
                If pocCol > 0 Then pocVal = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))
                If ncidPocList.Exists(pocVal) Then
                    sec = SEC_EL
                Else
                    sec = 0
                    elPocExcluded = elPocExcluded + 1
                End If
            Else
                sec = 0
                elSkippedCount = elSkippedCount + 1
            End If
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            If pri = 99 Then
                voidCt(sec) = voidCt(sec) + 1
            Else
                encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1

                If pri <= 2 Then
                    greenCt(sec) = greenCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri = 3 Then
                    pinkCt(sec) = pinkCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
                    ltGreenCt(sec) = ltGreenCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri = 6 Then
                    orangeCt(sec) = orangeCt(sec) + 1
                Else   ' pri = 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
                    draftCt(sec) = draftCt(sec) + 1
                    Dim statusText As String
                    statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                    If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"
                    If unrecognisedStatuses.Exists(statusText) Then
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) + 1
                    Else
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = 1
                    End If
                End If

                Dim teamDict As Object
                If sec = SEC_EM Then Set teamDict = emTeams Else Set teamDict = elTeams
                teamDict(team) = teamDict(team) + 1

                If usedFallback Then blankCCF(sec) = blankCCF(sec) + 1

                ' Numerator detail
                Dim cbTeam As String, lcTeam As String
                cbTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
                lcTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, latestCCF)
                If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edInit(sec) = edInit(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edFull(sec) = edFull(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then inflFull(sec) = inflFull(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidFull(sec) = ncidFull(sec) + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' ---- Missed FC count: File B (split by Admission Type) or manual entry ----
    Dim missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedOther As Long
    Dim missedFCSourceLabel As String

    If hasFileB Then
        missedFCSourceLabel = "Inflight Missed FC Report"

        Dim bEncCol As Long
        bEncCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
        If bEncCol > 0 Then
            Dim bLastRow As Long
            bLastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, bEncCol).End(xlUp).Row

            If bLastRow >= 2 Then
                Dim bAdmTypeCol As Long
                bAdmTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileBws, "Admission Type")

                If bAdmTypeCol > 0 Then
                    Dim bAdmData As Variant
                    bAdmData = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(2, bAdmTypeCol), _
                        fileBws.Cells(bLastRow, bAdmTypeCol)).Value

                    Dim bi As Long
                    For bi = 1 To bLastRow - 1
                        Dim bAdmVal As String
                        If bLastRow = 2 Then
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData))
                        Else
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData(bi, 1)))
                        End If

                        If bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
                            missedEM = missedEM + 1
                        ElseIf bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE) Then
                            missedEL = missedEL + 1
                        Else
                            missedOther = missedOther + 1
                        End If
                    Next bi
                Else
                    missedEM = bLastRow - 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Else
        missedFCSourceLabel = "manual entry (dashboard workaround)"
        missedEM = missedFCManualCount
        missedEL = 0
        missedOther = 0
    End If

    ' ---- Get report period label ----
    Dim reportLabel As String
    reportLabel = GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws)
    If reportLabel = "" Then reportLabel = "Unknown Period"

    Dim voidedTotal As Long
    voidedTotal = voidCt(1) + voidCt(2)

    ' ---- Create output workbook ----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim outWb As Workbook
    Set outWb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    ' EM sheet -- always produced
    Dim wsEM As Worksheet
    Set wsEM = outWb.Sheets(1)
    wsEM.Name = SHEET_EM
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEM, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EM
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEM

    ' EL sheet -- only when the NCID Point of Care list is configured (Decision 1)
    If elComputed Then
        Dim wsEL As Worksheet
        Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
        WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
        HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL
    End If

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided (Decision 5)
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, elComputed, elSkippedCount, elPocExcluded, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, elComputed, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    MsgBox "Unexpected error building output workbook:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    BuildOutputWorkbook = False
End Function

32	' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.

35	    Dim lastCol As Long

37

54	'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space

56	Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
57	    Dim t As String
58	    t = CStr(s)
59	    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")

61	    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
62	    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
63	    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0

67	End Function
